files.snippet: ## Software Engineer | Game Developer C++ Unreal Engine 5 Blueprints GAS Gameplay Porting Consoles Systems CI/CD Build Systems Animation Programming Vulkan OpenGL Python HTML5 Linux **Software Engineer** with **9+ years of experience** specializing in software architecture, gameplay and systems programming, performance optimization, cross-platform development, and Modern C++ (17/20/23). Graphics API enthusiast with a custom **Vulkan 3D Game Engine**. I’ve taken part in multiple **AA/AAA Unreal Engine** projects across all production stages (pre-release, mid-production, and greenfield), such as **Lords of the Fallen** (2023, PS5, XSX, PC), **Gothic Remake** (2026, PS5, XSX, PC), and **Remothered Tormented Fathers Remaster** / **Remothered Broken Porcelain Remaster** (2026, PS5, XSX, Switch 2, PC). I bring a strong engineering mindset, adaptability, and a hands-on approach to solving complex technical challenges. - **Email:** [adrian.egea.comenge(at)gmail.com](adrian.egea.comenge(at)gmail.com) - **LinkedIn:** [www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-egea-comenge](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-egea-comenge) Download CV pdf ## Profesional Projects ### Lords of the Fallen (2023) HexWorks (CI Games) ARPG Soulslike Multiplayer Coop Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX PC - Responsible for the Quest System, Save Game system, Serialization system, RPG features like items, stats, VFX/SFX/Wwise integration. Assisted with GAS abilities implementation and network replication for Coop mode. Identified and resolved critical gameplay bugs during development and post launch (patches and DLCs). Game optimization improving async loadings. > [Lords Of The Fallen V 2.5 | Full Game | Longplay Walkthrough Gameplay No Commentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsdvaonJiLk) ### Gothic 1 Remake (2026) Alkimia Interactive (THQ Nordic) ARPG Single Player Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX PC - Responsible for the Character/Creatures Movement and Animation Blueprints. Ported Blueprint animation code to C++. Assisted with Bugfixing, small creatures AI, GAS movement abilities implementation. > [GOTHIC 1 REMAKE Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME (4K 60FPS) No Commentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtLSazl7pd8) ### Quest System for Unannounced Project (2024) Underdog Studio (CI Games) Third Person Action Multiplayer Coop Unreal Engine 5 FlowGraph PS5 XSX PC - Quest System based in FlowGraph plugin with network replication for Coop mode. > [GitHub - MothCocoon/FlowGraph: Design-agnostic node system for scripting game’s flow in Unreal Engine](https://github.com/MothCocoon/FlowGraph) ### Modding System for Unannounced Project (2025) GRIP Studios Third Person Simulation Unreal Engine 5 Mod.io PS5 XSX PC - Modding System based in [Mod.io](https://mod.io/) for PC, PS5 and XSX. > [GitHub - modio/modio-ue: Unreal Engine Plugin for easily integrating mod.io into your game - the UGC management service for game developers](https://github.com/modio/modio-ue) ### Remothered Remastered (2026) Radical Dreams Entertainment 株式会社 Port Horror Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX Switch2 PC - Remothered Tormented Fathers and Remothered Broken Porcelain - Consoles Porting (PS5, XSX, Switch2), Cinematics Programming, UI Programming, Gameplay and Systems, CI/CD Pipeline setup (TeamCity) > [Remothered Remastered - Announcement Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ju3fe6C96uA) ### Cl3ver (2018) Cl3ver C++ OpenGL - Responsible for creation of Plugins for Rhinoceros and Google Sketchup. Responsible for refactoring and implementing new features for Oculus Rift App. > [CL3VER | Real-time Cloud RTX Rendering on Google Cloud](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C3ntpWgNbGw) ## Side Projects ### **C++ / OpenGL / Vulkan 3D Game Engine** C++ OpenGL Vulkan GLSL * Custom Vulkan 3D engine built for graphics and systems learning and research. [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/adrianensis/ForestEngine) * **Tech**: C++, CMake, Python, Vulkan, OpenGL 4.x, GLSL, SPIRV * **Features**: 2D, 3D, Hybrid ECS, Automatic Batching, Instanced Rendering, Data Driven Shaders Builder, Texture Atlases, Animation Spritesheets, Built-In Custom UI, Scene management, Perspective / Orthographic Camera, Stencil, Basic Input, Events Manger, Math module, Loading 3D models with GLTF, Skeletal Meshes, Skeletal Animation, GPU Skinning, Render Graph, Render Passes, PBR Shading, Directional Light, Shadow Mapping. > [C++ / OpenGL / Vulkan 3D Game Engine](https://github.com/adrianensis/ForestEngine) ### **JavaScript + WebGL 2D Game Engine** JavaScript WebGL GLSL * Lightweight Web 2D engine. [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/adrianensis/ThiefEngine) * **Tech**: JavaScript, WebGL, GLSL * **Features**: 2D, Texture Atlases, Animation Spritesheets, Scene management, Orthographic Camera, Basic Input > [JavaScript + WebGL 2D Game Engine](https://github.com/adrianensis/ThiefEngine) ### **Game AI Project** Java LibGDX State Machines Flocking Pathfinding (A*) Steering Behaviors Game AI * Implementation of autonomous agent behaviors and navigation algorithms. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/AI-Videogames-2016) * **Tech**: Java * **Features**: Pathfinding A*, Flocking, State Machines, Steering Behaviours > [Game AI Project](https://github.com/adrianensis/Artificial-Intelligence-Videogames-2016) ### Transpiler - Custom C++-Like Language C++ CMake * Simplified C++ to modern C++ transpiler. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/Compiler) * **Features**: Lexer, Parser, AST, Semantic Analisys, Code Generation ### RSS to Markdown Python tool Python HTML CSS JSON XML * Python script that download RSS info in Markdown format. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/rss-to-md) * **Tech**: Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, XML * **Features**: RSS download, RSS Cache, Human-like behaviour to avoid bans, categories ### Markdown to HTML Python tool Python HTML CSS JSON * Convert Markdown to HTML. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/md-to-html) * **Features**: sidebar navigation tree, sidebar table of content, pretty link cards, search bar
